note: The PR-7 gate conversations as user messages. Conversations 1 to 30 are the gate: TestConversations proves the deterministic half offline, and the catalog-only bar counts these alone. Conversations marked "probe" do not count toward the verdict. They exist to find catalog gaps, so they hold the shapes the gate set never takes: a user who changes their mind, contradicts themselves, asks a question back, or wants something the app can not serve. Their questions still reach the M-5 sheet (D-96). Conversations 53 to 66 are the terse set (D-105). Their users never repeat a value they already gave, so a redundant question strands the conversation instead of getting an answer. Every gate conversation before them restates the format at turn 2, which hid that defect and let both bars reward it. The terse set counts as probes, so the catalog-only bar stays comparable to runs 1 to 13.
